output.question: What is Tonix Pharmaceuticals' short interest?
output.answer: As of the latest explicitly dated report (October 15, 2026), Tonix Pharmaceuticals (TNXP) had 2,940,708 shares sold short—about 2.94 million shares—equal to 17.18% of its float, with 4.11 days to cover. [1](#cite-1) StockAnalysis also reports 2.94 million shares short and 15.13% of shares outstanding, but short interest is a reported, periodic position rather than a live measure. [2](#cite-2)

key_facts.fact: Tonix Pharmaceuticals (TNXP) had 2,940,708 shares sold short as of October 15, 2026.
The reported short position represented 17.18% of float and 4.11 days to cover as of October 15, 2026.
StockAnalysis reports TNXP short interest of 2.94M and short interest equal to 15.13% of shares outstanding.

passages.quote: As of Oct 15, 2026, TONIX PHARMACEUTICALS HOLDIN (TNXP) had 2.94M shares sold short, representing 17.18% of float.
The latest short interest is 2.94 million, so 15.13% of the outstanding shares have been sold short.
Short interest is the number of shares held in reported open short positions at a particular date.

caveats: Short interest is reported for a specific position date and is not a live measure of current short positions.
The sources use different denominators and presentation conventions: ChartMill reports 17.18% of float, while StockAnalysis reports 15.13% of shares outstanding.
